subject: Kickoff
text: Genuinely good session yesterday. My team came out of it more confident than they went in, which is not what I expected. Thank you.

subject: Re: Kickoff
text: Glad it landed. We will need payroll field sign-off by the 24th to hold the May 19 migration date.

subject: Migration date
text: So we have missed the 19th. I raised the earning-code gap on the 28th and again on the status call. What I need now is not reassurance, it is a dated plan I can hand to Dana.

subject: Thursday steering call
text: I have asked our COO to join Thursday. Before that call I want a written view on whether the June 15 go-live is still credible, and what the contractual position is if it is not.
